died.name: Boston Custer
died.desc: United States Army civilian contractor, brother of George Armstrong Custer and Thomas Custer
died.cause: asking about the location of his brother George prior to his death at the Battle of the Little Bighorn

died.name: George Armstrong Custer
died.cause: to Sergeant Charles Windolph prior to the Battle of the Little Bighorn
died.last_words: Orderly, I want you to take a message to Colonel Benteen. Ride as fast as you can and tell him to hurry. Tell him it's a big village and I want him to be quick, and to bring the ammunition packs.

died.name: Sadi Carnot
died.cause: mortally wounded by assassin, to Dr. Antonin Poncet, who told him his friends were there
died.last_words: I am grateful for your presence.

died.name: Richard Seaman
died.cause: on his deathbed after being fatally burned in a racing crash
died.last_words: I was going too fast for the conditions – it was entirely my own fault – I am sorry.

died.name: Hillel Slovak
died.cause: in a phone conversation with his brother before dying of a heroin overdose
died.last_words: I know, I love you, bro.

born.name: Erskine Childers
born.last_words: Take a step or two closer, lads. It will be easier that way.

born.name: Louis Mountbatten, 1st Earl Mountbatten of Burma
born.desc: British Royal Navy officer and statesman
born.cause: prior to death in IRA bombing of his fishing boat
born.last_words: Do you really think the IRA would think me a worthwhile target?
